messages:
Ken: Quick heads-up — staging embeddings latency spiked ~4-6% after yesterday's runtime patch. Root cause looks like a KV-cache edge-case. I have a small fix that avoids a race. Requesting expedited hotfix deploy to staging and short canary to prod.

maria: can you paste the minimal rollback + verification steps? need to signoff before we touch prod.

Ken: rollback is simple: pin back to v2.1.2 (current prod). Patch build is service-embed@2026.03.17-hotfix.2. Verification: 1) synthetic embed perf (p95 < 120ms), 2) no 5xx in the embeddings path for 15m, 3) sampler end-to-end smoke.

alice: ok, proposal — canary to 10% for 20m, if green, ramp to 50% for 10m then 100%. If any 5xx > 0.5% or p95 regresses >10% rollback immediately. @ops_lead you good with expedited window?

ops_lead: i'm good with that plan. mark as expedited; require pin documented in release notes + changelog entry. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy request created by Ken
- target: staging -> prod canary
- artifact: service-embed@2026.03.17-hotfix.2
- steps: canary 10% (20m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100%
- rollback target: service-embed@v2.1.2
- runbook: https://runbooks.internal/embed-hotfix
Status: awaiting approvals

frank-oncall: quick QA note — run the sampler with long-context prompts (1k tokens) in staging, we saw an edge at ~900 tokens yesterday.

Ken: good call. test included in smoke.

alice: approvals: @ops_lead ok, @maria ok. anyone else? otherwise i will trigger canary.

maria: ok from SRE side, telemetry dashboards are ready. watching embeddings.prod.latency & errors.

bob: +1 from ML infra — model kernels look clean.

alice: triggering canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary started
- canary id: cny-1768001234-1
- target: prod (10% traffic)
- artifact: service-embed@2026.03.17-hotfix.2
- started by: alice
- live checks: health / errors / latency

deploy-bot: Automated prechecks passed: smoke, lint, infra-health

maria: staging smoke ✅ (p95 112ms, 0 5xx in last 15m)

frank-oncall: sampler long-context test ✅

deploy-bot: Canary metrics (10m): errors 0.12% (threshold 0.5%), embed_p95 118ms (baseline 115ms, delta +2.6%) — within rollback thresholds.

alice: green. ramp to 50%.

deploy-bot: Ramp started -> 50% (10m window)

deploy-bot: Ramp metrics (8m): errors 0.07%, embed_p95 120ms (delta +4.3%) — still ok.

ops_lead: hold 5m at 50% per policy for sanity checks.

alice: holding.

maria: sanity checks pass (downstream consumer latencies stable). ready for 100% once hold complete.

alice: go to 100% in 2 minutes.

deploy-bot: Final ramp -> 100% initiated

deploy-bot: Deploy complete
- artifact: service-embed@2026.03.17-hotfix.2
- rollout: 100% prod
- time: 1768001368
- notes: expedited canary with 30m total ramp

Ken: great. pinned prod to service-embed@2026.03.17-hotfix.2
Command used:

redwoodctl pin --service=service-embed --env=prod --version=2026.03.17-hotfix.2 --reason="fix KV-cache race"

maria: updating changelog + release notes now: short note: "Fix KV-cache race in embeddings runtime — reduces intermittent latency spikes."

bob: keeping v2.1.2 artifact in retention group for 1h in case of fast rollback.

frank-oncall: monitoring. if errors >0.5% or p95 > baseline+10% within next 60m i will trigger rollback.

ops_lead: thanks team. please add the postmortem-ish blurb to the next weekly release notes if follow-up needed. closing thread when changelog is posted.

alice: changelog posted, release note added, closing. ✅

Ken: closing incident — thanks everyone.
